articles.title: Solana ETFs extend growth streak to 5 days after year's biggest inflows
articles.description: Monday's $33.5 million was the largest single-day inflow since December, pushing cumulative net inflows to a record $1.22 billion and trading volume to $166.8 million.

articles.title: New Delhi draws in $73 billion in 11 weeks, powered by special deposits for non-resident Indians
articles.description: India has attracted inflows of $73 billion in 11 weeks, driven mostly by foreign currency bank deposits made by non-resident Indians.

articles.title: Gold hovers near three-month high on dollar weakness, Treasury bond buyback plans

articles.title: Monad proposes wallet upgrade that could survive lost keys and quantum attacks
